issues.reason: The half that stands: *Propositional attitudes* makes Experiencer=the holder part of the attitude construction, so the inner say's sayer is genuinely absent; overstated because the antecedent-less-pronoun rule enumerates he/she/they/it and does not reach generic 'one' (the reviewer's own gap), and minting a person witness would recast a generic as an existential, so the omission adds nothing false.

The deictic 'at the moment' is indeed dropped, but the cited remedy does not apply here — the predicate is a PP ((At sk_euro_1 sk_level_1)), not a copular Member atom, so there is no property to reify and no flat form to keep beside it, and the instruction set directs leaving an unrepresentable adverbial out rather than mis-slotting it.

*Core patterns* / Sealing: a definite NP's Member/Name typing projects to top level 'in every sealing construct alike', so the definite 'the level' must be typed outside the seal exactly as sk_euro_1 and sk_fundamentals_1 are.

The 'at -> LocatedIn' routing belongs to *Where a THING is*, i.e. physical position; 'at the level' positions nothing physically, and the framing/domain-PP precedent ('in fluid mechanics' takes neither locative head but the preposition-named form) licenses the surface-preposition At, whereas LocatedIn would assert a containment that is false.

gaps_confirmed: generic / impersonal 'one' as a clause subject is outside the antecedent-less-pronoun list
an approximator hedging a non-numeric predicate ('is about at the level') — ParticleFromNormal covers numeric magnitudes only
a bare comparative adverb with no expressed standard ('better reflects the fundamentals')
positioning an entity on an abstract scale ('the euro is at the level') — neither LocatedIn nor an event oblique fits
new_gaps: direct quotation: a verbatim quoted utterance as the complement of 'said' has no licensed record — the quoted string itself is unrepresentable, so it is silently re-parsed as a that-clause seal
a capability generic with a clausal complement ('one CAN say that P') — the kind-level (Inheritance kind (can verb)) property form has no slot for the complement, forcing (Can e) on a sealed event
repair_summary: Moved (Member sk_level_1 level) out of the nested seal to a top-level atom (level_type), as the definite-referent projection rule requires; nothing else changed.
notes: The nested seal, the Experiencer on 'say' (licensed by *Propositional attitudes*), and the definite-plural group witness for 'the fundamentals' are all correct. Two content losses ('at the moment', 'better') stand as gap-territory omissions rather than defects.
